description: This file defines exception classes related to the payment service flows within the payment module, including custom exceptions like NotFoundException, ValidationException, ProviderException, and ConfigurationException.

classes.name: PaymentExceptions
classes.description: A final utility class encapsulating various custom exception types used in the payment service flows.

classes.name: NotFoundException
classes.description: Exception indicating a requested resource was not found within the payment context.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Exception indicating validation errors during payment processing.

classes.name: ProviderException
classes.description: Exception indicating issues originating from external payment providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationException
classes.description: Exception indicating configuration errors within the payment service.

methods.name: NotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a message string for NotFoundException.

methods.name: ValidationException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a message string for ValidationException.

methods.name: ProviderException
methods.description: Constructors to create ProviderException instances with a message and optionally a cause.

methods.name: ConfigurationException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a message string for ConfigurationException.
